# MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology

> MIT is a leading research university focused on education, scientific discovery, innovation, and public impact.

MIT’s primary web presence spans institutional information, academics, research, admissions, campus life, news, alumni engagement, and lifelong learning. The main site links to specialized services including MIT News, events, campus maps, directory search, jobs, and online learning.

## Main Site
- [MIT Homepage](https://web.mit.edu/): Institutional homepage with major stories, navigation, and links to academics, research, and campus resources.
- [About MIT](https://web.mit.edu/about): Overview of MIT’s mission, history, leadership, facts, and institutional priorities.
- [Search](https://web.mit.edu/search): Site search for MIT pages, resources, and institutional information.
- [Contact](https://web.mit.edu/contact): Central contact information and ways to reach MIT offices and services.
- [Visit MIT](https://web.mit.edu/visitmit): Visitor guidance, directions, tours, and planning information for coming to campus.
- [Accessibility](https://web.mit.edu/accessibility): Accessibility information and institutional commitments for digital and campus access.
- [Privacy](https://web.mit.edu/privacy): Privacy policy and information about data practices on MIT web properties.

## Education
- [Education](https://web.mit.edu/education): Overview of MIT’s educational programs, schools, and learning opportunities.
- [Admissions + Aid](https://web.mit.edu/admissions-aid): Central hub for undergraduate, graduate, and financial aid information.
- [Lifelong Learning](http://learn.mit.edu/): MIT learning opportunities for professional, online, and continuing education audiences.
- [People Directory](https://web.mit.edu/search/?redirect-origin=legacy&tab=directory): Search for MIT people, offices, and contact listings.
- [Events Calendar](https://calendar.mit.edu/): University-wide calendar of lectures, conferences, performances, and campus events.

## Research
- [Research](https://web.mit.edu/research): Institutional overview of MIT research across departments, labs, and interdisciplinary initiatives.
- [MIT News](https://news.mit.edu/): Official news source covering research advances, campus developments, and expert perspectives.
- [Events Calendar](https://calendar.mit.edu/): Research talks, seminars, symposia, and public academic events across MIT.
- [Map](https://whereis.mit.edu/): Campus map useful for locating labs, departments, centers, and buildings.
- [Jobs](https://hr.mit.edu/jobs): Faculty, research, staff, and administrative employment opportunities at MIT.

## Innovation and Entrepreneurship
- [Innovation](https://web.mit.edu/innovation): Overview of MIT’s entrepreneurship ecosystem, translational research, and startup culture.
- [Research](https://web.mit.edu/research): Research programs that feed innovation, commercialization, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
- [Lifelong Learning](http://learn.mit.edu/): Professional education and skill-building opportunities connected to MIT expertise.
- [MIT News](https://news.mit.edu/): Coverage of startups, technology transfer, and innovation-related breakthroughs from MIT.

## Campus Life and Community
- [Campus Life](https://web.mit.edu/campus-life): Student life, housing, wellness, activities, and community resources on campus.
- [Visit MIT](https://web.mit.edu/visitmit): Campus access, visitor planning, and orientation resources.
- [Map](https://whereis.mit.edu/): Interactive campus map for buildings, services, and navigation.
- [Events](https://calendar.mit.edu/): Public and campus events including arts, lectures, and student activities.
- [People](https://web.mit.edu/search/?redirect-origin=legacy&tab=directory): Directory for finding departments, offices, and individuals across MIT.

## News and Publications
- [MIT News](https://news.mit.edu/): Official MIT newsroom with research stories, campus news, and expert commentary.
- [Creating “humble” AI](https://news.mit.edu/): MIT News coverage of AI research and responsible system design.
- [Mapping mosquito flight](https://news.mit.edu/): MIT News coverage of modeling and biological engineering research.
- [Pneumonia detector](https://news.mit.edu/): MIT News coverage of medical sensing and diagnostic technology.
- [Forecasting heart failure](https://news.mit.edu/): MIT News coverage of AI-enabled health prediction research.
- [Spotlight archive](https://news.mit.edu/): Ongoing featured stories and institutional highlights from across MIT.

## Alumni and Giving
- [Alumni](https://web.mit.edu/alumni): Alumni programs, services, events, and ways to stay connected with MIT.
- [Give](https://web.mit.edu/building-a-better-world): Giving and philanthropy information supporting MIT’s mission and priorities.
- [About MIT](https://web.mit.edu/about): Institutional context useful for alumni engagement and philanthropic interest.
- [MIT News](https://news.mit.edu/): Stories demonstrating the impact of MIT research, education, and community.

## Administrative and Public Resources
- [Jobs](https://hr.mit.edu/jobs): Employment portal for open positions across MIT.
- [People Directory](https://web.mit.edu/search/?redirect-origin=legacy&tab=directory): Directory search for faculty, staff, students, and offices.
- [Events](https://calendar.mit.edu/): Public calendar for institutional, academic, and community events.
- [Map](https://whereis.mit.edu/): Official campus map and wayfinding resource.
- [Contact](https://web.mit.edu/contact): General contact channels and institutional assistance.
- [Visit MIT](https://web.mit.edu/visitmit): Public-facing visitor information and campus access details.

## Prospective Students
- [Admissions + Aid](https://web.mit.edu/admissions-aid): Starting point for applicants seeking admissions and financial aid information.
- [Education](https://web.mit.edu/education): Academic overview of MIT programs and educational structure.
- [Campus Life](https://web.mit.edu/campus-life): Student experience, housing, activities, and support resources.
- [Visit MIT](https://web.mit.edu/visitmit): Information for prospective students planning a campus visit.
- [About MIT](https://web.mit.edu/about): Institutional overview, facts, and mission for applicants and families.
